med_ex
v0.2.0

    Source development

    Copy Markdown View Source

    These instructions apply to the source repository checkout at https://github.com/nshkrdotcom/med_ex. They are not needed when installing :med_ex as a Hex dependency.

    Repository layout

    PathRole
    core/med_rtcCapture, evidence, preview, canonical WAV rules, and MedEx.Web browser assets and tests.
    build_support/weld.exsWeld manifest projecting core/med_rtc into the single :med_ex Hex package.
    dist/release_bundles/Gitignored output directory where mix weld.release.prepare writes the generated project/, rendered docs/, and .tar archive.

    Prerequisites (Ubuntu 26.04)

    Install system packages:

    sudo apt-get install -y git curl tar build-essential pkg-config libssl-dev

    (Install libopus-dev as well if compiling membrane_opus_plugin from source instead of using precompiled binaries.)

    Activate the exact Erlang and Elixir versions pinned in .tool-versions (erlang 29.1.2, elixir 1.20.5-otp-29) via asdf or mise. Use the pinned Node 24.19.0 for the browser helper tests; the sibling Fabric checkout uses the same version for its browser verification.

    Build, test, and prepare a release bundle

    Update the root VERSION file when bumping MedEx. The workspace projects and the Weld manifest share it, and the manifest derives the HexDocs projection tag.

    ./onboard.sh
mix ci
node --test core/med_rtc/test/*.mjs
mix weld.release.prepare

    mix weld.release.prepare prints the path to the generated bundle under dist/release_bundles/med_ex/<version>-<digest>/, containing:

    • project/ — standalone generated :med_ex Mix project (can be referenced as a local path dependency before Hex publication, or tested directly via mix deps.get && mix test).
    • docs/ — rendered ExDoc HTML preview (docs/index.html).
    • med_ex-<version>.tar — exact Hex archive.
    • release.json — source revision, verification checks, and SHA-256 digests.

    From a sibling med_fabric checkout, bash ops/qc_candidate.sh prepares that bundle and passes its exact project/ path to the exam via MF_MED_EX_PATH. It also runs the browser Node tests and checks that the three prepared assets match those tested SDK sources byte for byte. The exam's candidate lockfile lives under _build/; its committed Hex lockfile is not rewritten by this run.
